name: Lifeguard I Outdoor (seasonal)
org: City of Overland Park Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards watch swimmers at the city's public pools. They enforce pool safety rules and rescue swimmers in trouble. You must attend required training classes.
grades: Basic education equal to 8th grade for Lifeguard I
who_can_apply: Lifeguard I: at least 15 years old with an 8th grade education. You also need the city's Starguard lifeguard certification. Lifeguard II is 16 and up with one year of experience in Overland Park. Lifeguard III is 17 and up with two years.
pay_detail: Not stated on the job description
duration: Seasonal. Exact season dates not stated on the job description.
deadline_text: Current openings are not shown on the job description page. The job is listed as seasonal.
how_to_apply: The job description does not say how to apply. It requires Starguard certification from the City of Overland Park. The course is the Starguard Lifeguard Course.
notes: Quote from the job description: a minimum of 15 years of age. The job description does not state pay. Current postings and pay were not on the program page.
